# Consecutive Characters.

@example oo, kk and ee are the longest rows, two letters each.
"bookkeeper"
=> 2

@example The last five letters are all e.
"wheeeee"
=> 5

@example No letter is next to an equal one.
"qwerty"
=> 1

# A single letter.
"a"
=> 1

# The longest row is at the start.
"dddcc"
=> 3

# The only repeat is at the very end.
"abcdd"
=> 2

# Two letters taking turns.
"abababab"
=> 1

# x is the most frequent letter, but its copies are apart.
"xaxbxcxddd"
=> 3

# One letter in two rows split by another: the rows don't add up.
"ccccdccc"
=> 4

# Several rows tied for longest.
"ppqqrr"
=> 2

# 128 of one letter, past what a signed char can count.
"mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm"
=> 128

# 256 of one letter, one more than an unsigned char can count.
"kccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccdddddddddd"
=> 256

# The longest string allowed, all one letter.
""
=> 500

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"baa"
=> 2

@gen 2 small
"aaabb"
=> 3

@gen 3 small
"cbaaaaabbbaa"
=> 5

@gen 4 small
"bbaaaaaa"
=> 6

@gen 5 small
"bbaaaaaaab"
=> 7

@gen 6 small
"bbbcccaaaa"
=> 4

# Full-size cases from gen.c: 500 letters.
@gen 5
""
=> 63

@gen 6
""
=> 100

@gen 10
""
=> 289
